decision: Turned on noUncheckedIndexedAccess and narrowed indexed reads. Skipped exactOptionalPropertyTypes.
why: Index checks catch empty-deck and empty-location mistakes. exactOptionalPropertyTypes would churn optional fields without making new states impossible.
